messages:
emma: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Posting a follow-up thread for hiring/org questions we didn't get to. I'll answer what I can and loop in @leah and @raj for specifics. :wave:

sam: Quick clarification 3 is the headcount delta for FY26 final or still provisional?

leah: Provisional until finance publishes the final plan next week. Planning guidance: expect ~+12 net FTE for FY26 focused on Dedicated, SRE, and Product.

matt: Heard were consolidating some manager roles. Does that mean managers will be laid off or just not replaced?

raj: No mass layoffs. We're consolidating two infrastructure manager roles into one senior manager role to reduce duplication in scope; one role will be repurposed into IC hires (two senior ICs). Managers affected will be offered alternatives where possible.

cory: For teams that need immediate PM support for launches, what's our runway? Product says 3 PMs needed by next quarter.

emma: We're reallocating budget and prioritizing Product for the next hiring window. Teams should surface critical reqs to @leah by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Is there a freeze on new reqs? We have two open reqs on my team I could close if needed.

leah: No global freeze. Please keep existing reqs open; we'll triage and prioritize rather than close proactively. Send req IDs to me.

matt: If someone on Eng Infra wants to move to Runtime, what's the path? Any expected waiting period?

leah: Internal mobility stays active. Process: 2-week shadow, manager sign-off, then formal interview loop. We're creating an internal mobility channel and a short form to track moves.

dev-tools-bot: Doc uploaded: /docs/people/headcount-q3-q4-2026.md

cory: Will interview loops or the hiring bar change for the new consolidated manager role?

raj: Interview loop stays mostly the same. Manager loop will include an extra systems-level case for that combined scope. Hiring bar remains unchanged.

sam: For payouts/bonuses tied to headcount targets, any changes?

emma: No immediate changes to compensation programs. Finance will confirm if targets shift materially.

matt: Will we get a new org chart and mapping of who reports to whom?

leah: Yes, org chart and headcount spreadsheet will be posted tomorrow and I'll send a link here. Training for panel reviewers on the new role profile is scheduled Friday 11am. Recording will be available.

emma: Thanks everyone. If you have team-specific impacts, DM @leah or post here and we'll follow up.
